# Haplotype analysis plots

## Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

set_theme(theme_cowplot())
```

## Load Haplotype P-value data

Also load target SNP data and join it with haplotype data.

```{r}
hap2L <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/Haplotype_Inf/HapScan_2L.Rds")
hap2R <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/Haplotype_Inf/HapScan_2R.Rds")
hap3L <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/Haplotype_Inf/HapScan_3L.Rds")
hap3R <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/Haplotype_Inf/HapScan_3R.Rds")
hapX <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/Haplotype_Inf/HapScan_X.Rds")

haptotal <- bind_rows(hap2L, hap2R, hap3L, hap3R, hapX)

haptotal <- haptotal %>% rename(CHROM = ChArm, POS = Ppos) %>% drop_na()

target_SNPs <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/lm_targetSNPs.RDS")

target_SNPs <- target_SNPs %>% dplyr::select(CHROM, POS) %>% mutate(Target = "Significant")

haptotal <- haptotal %>% left_join(target_SNPs, 
                                      by = join_by(
                                        CHROM == CHROM, 
                                        POS == POS))

```

### Pivot longer and make boxplot of P-values

```{r}
hap_pvals <- haptotal %>% dplyr::select(CHROM, POS, ends_with("_p"), Target)

hap_pvals_long <- hap_pvals %>% pivot_longer(
  cols = contains("_p"),
  names_pattern = "(.*)\\_p",
  names_to = "Founder",
  values_to = "log10p"
)

ggplot(data = hap_pvals_long, 
       aes(x = Founder, y = log10p, color = Founder)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(x = "Founder Line", y = "-log10(P-value)")
```

### Adjust P-values

```{r}
hap_pvals_adj <- hap_pvals %>% mutate(across(
  .cols = ends_with("_p"),
  .fns = ~ p.adjust(10^(-.x), method = 'fdr'),
  .names = "{.col}_adj"
)) %>% dplyr::select(CHROM, POS, contains("_adj"), Target) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
  cols = contains("_adj"),
  names_pattern = "(.*)\\_adj",
  names_to = "Founder",
  values_to = "adj_p"
)

box_adj <- hap_pvals_adj %>%  
  ggplot(aes(x = Founder, y = -log10(adj_p), color = Founder)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), color = 'red') +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(x = "Founder Line", y = "adjusted -log10(P-value)")

print(box_adj)

plot_hap_O_adjPval <- hap_pvals_adj %>% filter(Founder == "O_p") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = POS, y = -log10(adj_p), size = -log10(adj_p))) +
  facet_grid(. ~ CHROM) +
  geom_point(data = . %>% filter(is.na(Target)), color = 'grey', alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = . %>% filter(Target == "Significant"), color = 'blue') +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 2) +

  labs(y = "-log10(LM: Adjusted P Value)", x = "SNP ID") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = 'dotted', color = 'red') +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = 'none',
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'grey98'), 
          panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"))
          
print(plot_hap_O_adjPval)
```

### Evaluating founder line differences

These are absolute differences between mean(CON1-4) and mean(FP1-4) at each SNP. See code in GenomeScan_Haplotypes.R:

output\[,paste0(hapi,"\_D")\]\<- abs(rowMeans(ffreq_all\[,hapi,1:4\]) - rowMeans(ffreq_all\[,hapi,5:8\]))

MA is mean of all A1:A8 D values at each SNP.

```{r}
hap_Dvals <- haptotal %>% dplyr::select(CHROM, POS, ends_with("_D"), Target) %>% pivot_longer(
  cols = contains("_D"),
  names_pattern = "(.*)\\_D",
  names_to = "Founder",
  values_to = "Difference"
)

hap_Dvals_box <- hap_Dvals %>% ggplot(aes(x = Founder, y = Difference, color = Founder)) + geom_boxplot() + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(x = "Founder Line", y = "Difference (CON vs. FP)")

print(hap_Dvals_box)

plot_hap_Dvals <- hap_Dvals %>% filter(Founder != "MA") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = POS, y = Difference, size = Difference, color = Founder)) +
  geom_vline(data = . %>% filter(Target == "Significant"),
             aes(xintercept = POS), color = 'grey25', alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(Founder ~ CHROM, space = "free_x", scales = "free_x") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 2) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.25)) +
  labs(y = "Difference (CON vs. FP)", x = "SNP ID") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = 'none',
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'grey98'), 
          panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"))
          
print(plot_hap_Dvals)
```

#### Save significant sites from O

```{r}
hap_pvals_adj %>% filter(Founder == "O_p") %>% 
  dplyr::select(CHROM, POS, adj_p) %>% 
  write_rds(file = "../../../Big_data/hap_pvals_adj.RDS")
```

## Inferred Base Population

```{r}
# read base population
base_pop <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/Base_pop_SNP_freq.RDS")

base_pop <- base_pop %>% mutate(CHROM = factor(CHROM),
                                Base_freq = unname(Base_freq))

# read filtered data
FF_filt <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/FF_genomes_filtered.RDS")

FF_inf_obs <- FF_filt %>% full_join(base_pop, FF_filt, 
                                    by = c("CHROM", "POS")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(CHROM, POS, Base_freq, starts_with("freq_")) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% pivot_longer(
  cols = starts_with('freq_'),
  names_to = c(".value", "Population"),
  names_pattern = "(freq)_(.*)") %>% 
  # Removes all text after the second underscore,
  # used to remove _G13_sample...
  # this leaves freq_CON1, N_CON1, and so on.
  mutate(Population = str_remove(Population, "_.*")) %>% 
  separate_wider_regex(
    cols = Population,
    patterns = c("Selection" = ".*", "PopReplicate" = "\\d$")
    ) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Selection", "PopReplicate"), factor) %>% 
  mutate(dev_frm_base = Base_freq - freq)
```
